subject: Payment cadence & PO ACK lane mapping for Northward Systems onboarding
body:
From: Elena Morales <elena.m@northwardsys.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marcus Holt <mholt@northwardsys.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup details + payment cadence

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the walkthrough on Friday. We reviewed Redwood's onboarding checklist internally — procurement had two asks before we can issue a PO: 1) confirmation of our preferred billing cadence (Net 45), and 2) a mapping of PO ACK lanes so our AP system can auto-route invoices into the correct payment bucket.

Historically Northward runs Net 60 but we're open to Net 45 for new vendors that meet our early-pay discount program (net + discount). If Redwood needs faster cashflow, we can consider a pilot that pays Net 30 for the first 90 days, then steady to Net 45.

Attached is our vendor intake form and a sample PO layout. Can you confirm if Redwood supports:
- custom PO header fields (vendor tier / bill-to code) for ACK mapping
- invoice PDF matching to PO number for automated matching
- an early-pay option (e.g., 1% for payment within 10 days) that we can include on the PO

If helpful, Marcus from AP is on copy and can share the specific XML/CSV that our vendor portal expects.

Cheers,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, Northward Systems
[Attachment: Northward_Vendor_Form.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Northward_PO_Template.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.m@northwardsys.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup details + payment cadence

Elena — thanks for the clear note and attachments. Short answers up front: yes to the three items you listed.

A quick summary of our proposed alignment options so we can choose the simplest path for AP automation:

Option A (preferred for predictability):
- Redwood signs standard vendor agreement, onboards into portal
- Billing cadence: Net 30 standard; provide early-pay 1% if paid within 10 days (this will be surfaced on invoice lines)
- PO ACK mapping: we can add a custom PO header "AP_ROUTE" or use the bill-to code; our finance team will accept either as long as the field is present in the invoice PDF

Option B (compromise):
- Pilot for first 90 days: Net 30 settlement, then convert to Net 45
- Redwood accepts a 45-day payment SLA afterwards with an optional early-pay program for faster settlement

Option C (for larger multi-phase deals):
- Milestone billing (30/30/30) with POs per milestone; each PO will include the AP routing field

Action items I propose:
- Rishi to return signed vendor form (attached)
- Monica to map our PO template fields to Northward's sample and confirm XML/CSV column names
- Northward (Marcus) to share expected header name for the portal (AP_ROUTE or equivalent)

I'll attach a clean vendor form PDF and our standard PO template. If you prefer, we can do the Net45 conversion after the 90-day pilot to respect your internal policy.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Form_Fillable.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (XLSX)]

---
From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Northward onboarding — mapping & discount decision

Team — forwarding Northward's asks. Key points and my recommended approach:

Summary:
- Northward requests Net 45 by default; open to Net 30 pilot + early-pay discount.
- They need a PO ACK routing field for automation (likely "AP_ROUTE" or "BILLTO_CODE").

Questions for Monica (Finance):
- Can we operationally support Net 30 for first 90 days then flip to Net 45 automatically? If so, we should document that in the onboarding checklist and pass a note to Billing Ops.
- For early-pay discounts, what discount rate can we accept? I proposed 1% for pay within 10 days — Monica, ok to accept that without escalating?

Questions for Lauren (Ops):
- Can you add a field mapping task to adjust our e-invoice parser to accept an "AP_ROUTE" header? If we can support both AP_ROUTE and a fallback to bill-to code, it will reduce back-and-forth.

Proposed language for the PO we send: 
"Payment terms: Net 30 for the first 90 days, converting to Net 45 thereafter. Early payment option: 1% discount if payment is remitted within 10 days of invoice date. Invoices must include PO number and AP_ROUTE/BILLTO_CODE in the invoice header for automated routing."

I'll wait for Monica/Lauren to confirm — if green, I'll update the vendor form, sign, and send to Northward.

Thanks,
Rishi

---
From: Elena Morales <elena.m@northwardsys.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Marcus Holt <mholt@northwardsys.com>, procurement@northwardsys.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 15:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup details + payment cadence

Rishi — thanks, that all looks reasonable. Marcus confirmed the portal will accept "AP_ROUTE" and will include the XML spec by end of day Friday. We also confirmed internally that Net 30 pilot + convert to Net 45 fits our internal controls.

We signed the SOW and vendor form (attached) and returned them via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/samplesign/NORTHWARD-12345

Next steps:
- Northward to issue initial PO (we expect it this week)
- Redwood to send invoice after PO acceptance; include AP_ROUTE on all invoices
- Monica — please confirm acceptance of the 1%/10-day discount and whether we should publish that as a permanent option or pilot-specific line item

Thank you — looking forward to getting this live.

Best regards,
Elena

[Attachment: Signed_SOW_Northward.pdf (PDF)]
